nom: Wildfleur Salicylic Acid 2.0% + Willowherb Clarifying Toner

avis.titre: Nice product to add to routine
avis.texte: Nice and light. Doesnt smell. Doesnt feel heavy. Not really sure what it is doing.

I tried this out because I have some blemishes and clogged pores. After using this product for a while I didn't see much change. Perhaps it doesn't work well with my skin type. But it may help others.

This toner really helps balance my sebum / oil level on my nose without drying me out. I have super sensitive skin so im either too dry or super oily with closed comedom pimples on my nose that never want to pop. Love this toner and love that an ingredient is flowers 🌷.
I use this religiously, it makes my skin really smooth and it cleared it up.
I've tried similar things and that were more expensive and this is less than half the cost and very effective for my oily acne prone skin. I'd definitely recommend it!

I love this toner. I've been using it for about 1 month now. I was surprised to find out that it's actually a Korean brand. The product makes my ores so small and makes my skin feel plump and bouncy. I love use it right before my face serum. It doesn't burn or feel cold either. I love the packaging it's bottled in a very different type of container.
Nothing above and beyond but definitely not bad either. Good for anyone looking for a clarifying toner.

Application is extremely easy! I begin by cleansing my face, then I take a cotton pad and saturate it with toner and smooth all over my face and neck and even on my décolleté area. That's all it takes to tone your skin effectively. After about 2 1/2 weeks I noticed extremely hydrated skin which is a major plus for me because I have combination skin leaning on extra dry during summer months. And roughly after 3 weeks my skin was ACTUALLY smoother AND brighter! Can't ask for more than that in a toner. ** Also, can we give a round of applause for this bottle's beautiful color!
Surprisingly hydrating and sits well under makeup and other skincare. It made a huge difference calming down my skin if I had a long night and didn't wash my face. I will definitely be purchasing.

I have always struggled with sensitive dry skin and breakouts. I decided to start taking better care of my skin so I was very excited when I got the chance to try out this toner for free. Thank you Wildfleur! I've been using this toner every day for over a month. I've noticed a huge change in my skin. It's not as dry and my skin feels cleaner. It feels smoother and my makeup doesn't crack like it used to. It's also helped balance out my skin tone. I have dark spots and acne scars and they have faded a bit. Not entirely gone but they are slightly less noticeable. I'm so happy with the results so far. If that wasn't enough, it has beautiful packaging. The bottle is a bright fun color and very aesthetically pleasing.

I incorporated this toner into my routine after cleansing my face. As someone with sensitive skin I was pleased that the product did not break me out. I didn't notice any difference from other products im using.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I really love the color of the packaging. It's a pretty magenta. The product itself is clear and does not really have a scent to it. It helped tighten my skin and the help with overall dullness and appearance. It was easy to use, there is a small hole when you open up the lid and pull off the foil. And then you can squeeze us onto a cotton ball and use it on your face after cleansing your face. I use this product every single day for two weeks and I noticed a change in my skin. It is a lot softer, I feel like I'm glowing.

I use this toner everyday with a cotton pad after washing my face. I love that it is gentle! Sometimes I have issues with salicylic acid, but I didn't get any irritation while using this product. It's a plus that the packaging is super cute too!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I use this product a cotton round after I wash my face .The toner makes my faces feel refreshed

This Wildfleur Clarifying Toner has two star ingredients: 2% salicylic acid and willowherb. I'm very familiar with using salicylic acid, a beta hydroxy acid, and do use it along with products containing alpha hydroxy acid as well. My previous salicylic acid toner contained the same 2% strength but is pretty harsh. That is not the case with Wildfleur's. It's very gentle. It helps resurface my skin and clean up any dirt buildup while helping prevent and treat breakouts. My introduction to the benefits of flavonoids in willowherb have been pleasant. They can help stimulate collagen production and have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits along with a long list of others. After washing my face, I put some onto a cotton pad and apply it on my face. I love trying Korean beauty products! Will continue to use! Glad to have received this for free courtesy of Wildfleur in exchange for my honest thoughts.

This toner is really good for when I have breakouts or when my pores are feeling angry. I like to use it during that time of the month when my breakouts are worse and I use it in combo with other acne clearing products. It doesn't have a strong scent or any scent at all really. Cute packaging too!

After using my skin cleanser I apply this toner with a cotton pad. I have used this product for a couple of weeks now and have noticed a difference in my skin. My skin has cleared and feels soft. I have sensitive skin so this product has not caused me to break out.

avis.titre: I really enjoy wearing this toner
avis.texte: Before given the opportunity to sample the Wildfleur 2.0% Salicylic acid clarifying toner i didn't know about the brand. I actually like this product beacuse when you put it on it doesn't leave your face feeling sticky and the skin absorbs it very quickly. I also liked how it clarifies, brightens and helps with getting even skin tone. I've been using for about 2 weeks and i have noticed some changes in my skin especially in my old acne scars. I think its use it continuously, my skin tone will even out better.

I've been using this for a while now after cleansing my face and I love it so far! It's so soothing and feels good on my skin. My biggest issue is breaking out but it hasn't happened so that's amazing!!
Me gusta que me ayudo a desaparecer algunas marquitas de acné.

avis.titre: I love this Toner it's a definite 2x daily go to product,
avis.texte: I use this product after I wash my face so before bed and then again in the morning! I have very oily face so keep my fingers 2 or 3x use Is due to my oil-ness, after continued use I have seen dramatic results in my skins brightness and overall just dewy flawless look / without makeup I must add! I have been able to go days with out any foundation or spot corrections on! I just love this product! With it I have found I don't need a heavy face wash it really dose all the work I ask for in a face product!

avis.titre: A great new product to try!
avis.texte: I really enjoyed this product! I have never used Salicylic acid before in my skincare routine so this was definitely a first for me! I used it both to treat my forehead acne and to clear up some of the buildup in my hair. This product felt really hydrating even as it helped to clear up my acne in the first three weeks of using it. It also allowed my hair to feel more light and shinier!

Not only is the packaging so cute but it helped cleared my skin. I've been suffering with acne and this helped so much with getting rid of them and preventing acne marks. It super hydrating to the skin as well! Such a game changer.

avis.titre: This will remain part of my routine!
avis.texte: This salicylic acid serum is a great option to add to your beauty routine. It's not a cream as it has a watery texture so I feel it's more of a toner comparable to witch hazel. It has helped improve my skin and alleviated the redness I have in my cheeks. I will continue to use it in my daily routine!

First and foremost I want to say that this product is amazing. I apply the product on a cotton pad. I make sure I put enough on there to make sure I use it on my face and neck. As I'm providing a video of the product you can see my impurities on the cotton pad. My face feels so clean. I use 2 different facial cleansers on the shower. So to see my face dirty even after my face wash really shocks me. I have tried other toners however I broke out on some. This one I haven't. I do recommend this product to consumers. I promise you won't go wrong with this product. It also has 2 % salicylic acid in it to remove dead skins cells and reduce dead cells. WildFleur is my number one product now. Thank you!
I noticed the product did help dry out pimples slightly but not too dramatically. I think it's good for sensitive skin and when u don't want to dry out the area too much. I will continue use.

This product works great for preventing acne, especially along my chin. I have combination skin, and this toner moisturizes while decreasing oil in my oily spots, but it is also refreshing and gentle enough for the dry spots.

Probably one of the best toners I've tried so far. The consistency is a little thicker than water so it's better to use your hands rather than a cotton pad, plus bit saves you on product. I've noticed that my skin has been a lot smoother with less flakes patches thanks to its exfoliating properties. It also doesn't dry out my skin like most toners do. I've also noticed a more even toners to my appearance. Nothing too extreme but noticeable enough.

I have never tried anything from the brand Wildfleur Skincare before; however, this Salicylic Acid Clarifying Toner is great. The packaging is beautiful and very enticing to use. The formula is gentle so my skin wasn't irritated by this new product. Also, it has helped even my complexion and soften my skin. I'll definitely continue to use this product and will be on the lookout for new Wildfleur products.

avis.titre: A must have for your skincare routine!
avis.texte: I applied the product with either a cotton ball and cotton pads, they both worked equally great. Once applied, I let the product dry down before applying my morning SPF. This clarifying toner definitely improved my skin's texture. The product also helps with exfoliation with removing my daily makeup and dirt build-up. I really love that this clarifying toner has clean ingredients, vegan and cruelty free.
Powerful yet gentle proof is in the pudding took some incredible before and after photos I'm so happy. Please send me everything. No over powering scent. And my skin looks and feels amazing

I have rosacea so I'm very choosy and what I put on my skin, especially when it comes to exfoliating products. I've noticed more hydrating skin during this harsh winter and less bumps. Overall a total winner

Got to try this out thanks to the Korean skincare brand Wildfleur and BzzAgent in exchange for my honest feedback, this clarifying toner is applied after cleansing and helps remove any excess dirt and gunk left behind to keep your skin nice and clean and ready for your favorite moisturizer. I felt like this would be an absolute fantastic toner for someone with mainly oily or acne prone skin but my skin is a tad bit more on the dry and slightly sensitive side with this weather so a heavy moisturizer in my case was a must to prevent over drying and some sensitivity. I am also early forties so I felt this toner was a better fit for my younger twenties daughter as her skin is not as dry and sensitive as mine, I would buy this again specifically for her as it has done very well for her complexion!

Salicylic Acid also brightens the complexion, reduces inflammation, and can even help reduce fine lines and wrinkles. Another key ingredient is WillowHerb, rich in Flavonoids, which protect the skin from environmental stressors while also acting as anti-inflammatory and detoxifying agents, working in tandem with the Salicylic Acid to fight bacteria. Initially, I was concerned because I have dry skin in the winter, and I've always associated Salicylic Acid with oily or acne-prone skin. However, I decided to give it a try, knowing how powerful and beneficial it can be. I was pleasantly surprised. The cleanser has a gel-like consistency that foams up beautifully, creating a rich lather that felt gentle and non-drying. It rinses clean and doesn't leave any residue. After using it for some time, l've even received compliments on how radiant my skin looks! I would definitely repurchase this product, and I highly recommend it.
This Salicylic Acid Clarifying Toner is so awesome! It's lightweight, fragrance-free, and it helps brighten. Love the hydration and the way my skin feels after using it. Love the results of using it!
It has been a really long time since I've found a toner as wonderful as this one. My face feels and looks so much better!
I really enjoyed this product as it compares to my usual drugstore brand.

avis.titre: Great product that I would recommend again!
avis.texte: I really enjoyed this toner. The packaging was very chic and the bottle was a beautiful lavender color. It also had a nice floral smell and really toned down the redness in my cheeks.
I really enjoyed this toner. I noticed a difference in my skin texture and visible signs of acne. The packaging was great and really enhanced my skincare routine.

I got this product from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I have dry and sensitive skin and I am usually concerned about using such toners but there is no adverse reaction to this toner. I used it for around a week and my skin feels a lot smoother and brighter.

avis.titre: Great packaging, so far so good
avis.texte: I like to try things for a while to see if there's any reaction or benefit to share. Haven't been using this one long enough to say. But it does come packaged nicely and I will update once there's anything to share.

This product didn't do anything for my skin. It wasn't bad but it wasn't good. It was okay. I like that it didn't have a scent and the texture was good but after using it for weeks it didn't do anything for my skin and there were no changes so I would rather keep with my usual skin routine

First can I say how cute the packaging is!!! I love that it doesn't have a chemically smell like other toners I have tried in the past. It leaves your face feeling soft and refreshed. I would definitely recommend this product to others

avis.titre: Effective Exfoliating Toner for Smoother Skin
avis.texte: As a 35-year-old Asian female with normal skin, my routine includes toner, serum, moisturizer, and SPF in the daytime. I received Salicylic Toner A for free in exchange for my honest review and have been using it for two weeks as a daily nighttime toner before my HA serum step. With its watery, fragrance-free formula, it absorbs quickly and starts working within days—I noticed gentle skin shedding by day three, revealing a smoother texture. It exfoliates well, comparable to Paula's Choice 2% BHA, but requires a good moisturizer to prevent dryness. Since it increases skin sensitivity, it's essential to apply SPF in the daytime to protect the skin. It fits well into my routine, and I appreciate its effective yet gentle formula. I'd consider purchasing it again for regular exfoliation.

avis.titre: This toner leaves my skin oil-free for hours.
avis.texte: This toner leaves my skin oil-free for hours, it's gentle on my skin as well. It leaves my skin soft. It has a nice pleasant smell.
I love how it gives me a deep exfoliation. And it has overall improved my skin texture and has completely reduced my breakouts. I also love how my skin looks so much clearer and better.

I have tried A LOT of toners but this one is special. I used the product for two weeks straight morning and night and I've noticed improvements to my skin already. My skin feels soft and I have such a radiant glow. Even with bring a 2% AHA sometimes it can cause damage before good and that wasn't experienced with this time product. I also can tell the difference with the exfoliation. There should be more information on the packaging for usage but other than that I would recommend.

I have sensitive skin and have been happy with how this product applies and feels on my skin. I was impressed with the packaging and overall look of the product, and am excited to finishing the bottle and seeing long term results!

avis.titre: I will use all the time
avis.texte: I was amaze of how good this works, I feel my skin more smooth and healty as soon of a few days after use

After trying this toner I have to say, it's truly Amazing! From the cute and informative packaging and fancy bottle to the great product! I'm a believer! It smells good and it feels even better on your skin. I'm all for anything clarifying and this did exactly that! I need a TON of this toner to last me a lifetime!

avis.titre: Will definitely buy this product after it's gone.
avis.texte: It's the perfect toner. It leaves your skin feeling refreshed and soft. No harsh smells or chemicals in it. I will definitely be purchasing more in the future and the packaging is beautiful. Not that that matters but it definitely helps.

I received a bottle of the Wildfleur Clarifying Toner to try in exchange for my honest review. Starting with the basics, it doesn't really have a smell, at most a very mild scent. Upon first applying it definitely made my skin red but not in an irritated way. A few swipes across the skin produced a cotton ball full of dirt/makeup EVEN though I had used it AFTER I cleansed. I was shocked. My other toners did not produce the same results. I started off by using it a few days a week 1x a day as instructed and worked up more. It was obviously that it was clarifying but after 2 weeks use I did notice my skin more dry and my make up began flaking. It's possible I need a lower strength toner or need to use it less often. Overall, I did see a bit of a difference but not sure it's worth the dry skin.
Loved how Salicylic Acid Clarifying Toner left my skin, I got for free to try and I absolutely loved it!!!!!
I have been using the product every night. It has a mild scent. It does not dry out my skin. My skin looks better because my pores are cleaner.

I started using toner about 5 years ago, and I've tried out different ones (based on friend's and TikTok recommendations) and this one is my favorite one. I had never used this brand before and I don't like that instructions are so vague (I like to know how many times a week to use the product, how many drops per use, etc.) but this is one is my favorite! I like using it night makes my skin look well in the morning

This toner is scentless and a little thicker in consistency (less like water) than what I would use a cotton pad for. I use my palms to apply it onto the face and it has been working in both saving product and for getting the maximum amount of product onto the face. The toner only has 2% Salicylic Acid which is quite low so it did not irritate my skin or cause redness despite the fact that I have not used AHAs or BHAs in a long time. I have not seen dramatic results, however the patch of skin on my chin that I have had trouble with all my life is less bumpy and the pores feel/look clearer when combined with consistent use with the rest of my routine. If you're new to using BHAs, this toner actually did cause two small red spots on the first couple days that I used it because it pushed out yucky stuff in the pores so they looked like mini pimples that disappeared within 24 hours, but again it was only two and for some reason they were in areas that I never usually get pimples. If you are patient, you should see some results even if this is the only product in your routine that has acids. Overall, it appears to be gentle and great for those just getting into using acids or adding to a routine that is already BHA-heavy. For me, it is not effective enough to be a mainstay in my routine in the longrun.

I really like this toner, it has been great for exfoliating the skin and keeping pores clear. I can tell you the difference after using it for 2 weeks. I will continue using it and would recommend it to a friend.

I have sensitive skin, so I'm always cautious about trying new products, but the salicylic acid clarifying toner did not irritate my skin whatsoever. After about a week of use, I noticed a more even skin tone, less regular irritation, and my skin felt really clean. The packaging is also very appealing, and I appreciated the thoughtful design. I've continued to use this toner and am seeing great results. Highly recommend for anyone with sensitive skin looking for a gentle yet effective option!

I love this toner! It's from Wildfleur. The bottle is cute and pink. I use this tone every single day. I love to use it and then put moisturizer on. It's very refreshing. I use a pad most days. It doesn't have a scent which I love. My face can feel the difference in such a good way.

I like this as a toner. It works well and it doesn't irritate my skin. I however don't like the lack of description or how to use on the bottle or box. It could be confusing to those who are new to using this type of product. I can't say it improved my skin in any way. I will continue to use the product but not sure if I would purchase once completely empty.

avis.titre: Need more time for a good review
avis.texte: I have no negative comments about the product. I feel to see results i needed more time to test the product. But overall it smells ok, not tacky or sticky when applying. Bottle is good size, if using this everyday (not going run out fast). Bottle is a pretty color (fuchsia)

avis.titre: I would buy this over and over again
avis.texte: This toner works so well, it goes on easy, absorbs fully and leaves my skin looking and feeling so soft and moisturized. This was easily added into my skincare routine and works well with the products that I already use. Even better, this product had instant results with my skin looking and feeling healthier. I will purchase this over and over again!
I always a bit skeptical of the ambitious claims that skin care products make, but this one works. I have used topical salicylic acid before, and this one seems to work better than others!

First of all the pink bottle looks cute. Second of all I tried to apply every morning and night time routine, it has acid so feel skin very clean and dry, after this toner I put serum and moisture hydration. So far I like this toner. Also need sun screens.

avis.titre: Works for my sensitive, combination skin
avis.texte: I have been using this toner every morning without any skin irritation. The product is scentless and has the consistency of water. I was worried about a salicylic acid product drying out my skin, but I haven't noticed that happening! I appreciate that this consists of clean ingredients as well.

I have sensitive skin, struggle with scarring, and uneven skin tone. I've used a ton of different toners and this was the first one that didn't make my face feel like it was burning. I honestly didn't think it was working because it didn't have any tingle but I stuck to it and noticed results almost immediately. My skin is soft, more even and bright, and just looks so good!

This Salicylic Acid Clarifying Toner is excellent for keeping my skin clear and balanced. It gently exfoliates, reduces breakouts, and leaves my skin feeling refreshed without over-drying. The formula is lightweight and absorbs quickly, making it perfect for daily use. Highly recommended for those with oily or acne-prone skin!

avis.titre: Perfect toner for my Oily Skin
avis.texte: This toner helped with my hyperpigmentation. I also noticed that my skin didn't get as oily through the day which is really big for me. I usually get extremely oily halfway through the day.

I love this toner! Let's start with the packing, I an thoroughly impressed with the packaging that it came in, including the bottle itself. The actual toner is amazing to for several reasons. One being, the toner takes my skin routine to another level, leaving my skin feeling refreshed and very clean. Another bonus is that this toner is fragrance free so it's perfect for those with skin sensitivity. 10/10, highly recommend!

I use this toner on nights I don't use Tretinoin, so one night this and then one night T. I really love this product, i have dry/combination skin and am prone to peeling/dryness throughout the day. This toner really helps even my skin tone and with the acne I have been seeing crop up.

avis.titre: I have used them for 2 weeks but nothing change
avis.texte: I used them morning and night after cleaning and before moisturizing. I don't see anything changed and improved. My skin started getting red so I stopped using for 3 days and reapplying again but only night time. So far it's same as other toner. Nothing that to impress me

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: This toner worked wonders on my skin! It provided gentle exfoliation without the need for harsh scrubs, leaving my face feeling smooth and refreshed. Best of all, it balanced my skin without any dryness or irritation. If you're looking for an effective yet gentle toner, I'd definitely recommend this one!
I like that the salicylic acid doesn't cause any burning to my face since I have really sensitive skin but it doesn't really seem like it does anything. I haven't seen any changes in my skin.
I do like using it, I wish it wasnt super watery because it kept dripping on the sides of my face but overall it was good.

avis.titre: A Must-Have for Clearer, Smoother Skin
avis.texte: I've been using the Salicylic Acid Clarifying Toner for a few weeks now, and I'm honestly impressed! My skin feels fresher, smoother, and much clearer. The formula is lightweight and absorbs quickly, without leaving any sticky residue, making it perfect for my daily routine. The salicylic acid really helps with clearing out my pores and reducing the appearance of breakouts. I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin texture—my face feels smoother, and the overall tone looks more even. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin but still works wonders on stubborn acne. I also love how it helps control oil without over-drying my skin. My complexion looks more balanced, and I haven't had any irritation or redness. If you're looking for an effective toner that helps clarify and refresh your skin, this is definitely worth trying!

avis.titre: This is my new go to toner.
avis.texte: This tone left my face feeling super refreshed and smooth. I enjoyed how i didn't feel a sting.

avis.titre: I would definitely purchase this item again!
avis.texte: I have been using it on a cotton after washing my face in the morning and evening time. The product does not dry out your skin, and it helps to control oil. I noticed I have less breakouts currently. The package is eye catching, but I feel it's also wasteful.

avis.titre: I will be buying this again
avis.texte: It has only the smell of alcohol which isn't a bad thing, means there's no fake fragrance. I tried it on a really deep, cystic ache spot that was just forming & normally takes days to come to the top & is very painful! I washed my face & then applied the toner over top of the offensive zit for about a minute. To my surprise the next day it had risen to the top of my skin. I was so thankful I didn't have to go through the days long end of a huge pimple in the middle of my face! I used the toner for another week & my skin cleared thanks to the salicylic acid in the toner. I'll definitely continue using this product & I recommend it to anyone who's got some acne.

This toner is very hydrating. I apply if after using a gentle cleanser and top it off with a thick moisturizer. My skin felt soft and held onto the moisturizer for much longer than when I don't use the toner.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again!
avis.texte: After adding the clarifying toner to my skin care routine I have noticed a difference in my skin! My acne prone skin looks clear and my pores have become reduced. It has significantly soothed my skin.

I have been looking for a good SA toner for a while now so it was great to get one to sample from a company I had previously not been aware of. This toner absorbed into my skin really well and didn't leaves any sort of residue, just left my face feeling really smooth and clean. It also had no scent at all, which I prefer with this sort of product and it didn't dry my skin out at all which is another problem I often face. I loved the packaging and the product dispenses really well from the bottle. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a clarifying toner that won't dry your skin out.

I've been using this toner for about a week and a half. I have noticed a bit of an improvement in my skin tone and texture. I will definitely be keeping it in my skincare routine to see how much it improves my skin over a longer period of time. I do have sensitive skin on the dryer side and this toner did not irritate my skin at all. I received this product free for an honest review but will be continuing to use this and leaving an updated review after more use.
I absolutely love this clarifying toner. It smells amazing and leaves my face feeling so clean, clear and soft. I would highly recommend to someone looking for an amazing clarifying toner.

Great product I love this toner! The exfoliaton is unlike other exfoliating products I have tried. It Made my skin feel silky soft and it smoothed the texture of my skin. Didn't fry me skin out like other brands I have used in the past. I also liked that it had no chemical smell to it.

I applied the toner with cotton ball after cleansing my face, each morning. The toner was cool and refreshing, very clean feeling. My skin feels smooth & more vibrant. When applying it does feel a little tacky before drying.

avis.titre: The difference I was looking for
avis.texte: I understand that it typically take 4-6 weeks of regular use to see improvements in acne, but I started seeing improvements on the little bumps on my face in just one week. This formula does NOT sting, smell, or burn in any way. I'm excited to see how it will continue to exfoliate my skin to reveal a better looking complexion. I would reccomend!

I used this product in the morning and night in place of my regular toner and in addition to my other beauty care products. This product was great, it hydrated my skin and didn't dry it out or irritate it, at all. I would recommend this product for users that are looking to freshen up their toner routine.

Full disclosure that I received this to try out and review but I don't give things 5 stars unless I really like it. I don't know how this toner would feel on someone with more sensitive skin, but for my oily and acne prone skin that isn't sensitive at all. And since my eyes are more sensitive than my skin, I can also point that it doesn't have a fragrance that feels irritating to my eyes. My skin has been pretty consistently clear from breakouts and I've been able to use more most days of the week without it feeling too strong or like it could irritate my skin barrier. I'd purchase this with my own money.
Feels refreshing and has helped control my acne! Smells good too! Would purchase 10/10 recommend!

It was a pleasure trying this brand. It is a new one to me and it left a great impression. I used this as my toner before moisturizing and it leaves your skin feeling clean. Following with a moisturizer and sunscreen, you see great skin.

Great toner it has a soft scent and doesn't dry sticky. It's ery gentle on the skin and seems to be taking me texture away. I do use it every other day since I do have sensitive skin overall it's great and definitely recommend it.

Thanks Wildfleur for the free Salicylic Acid Clarifying Toner! I've been using this nightly as part of my skincare routine for about 2 weeks, and my face seems clearer and brighter! I have naturally dry skin, but surprisingly, this toner has not been dehydrating at all. The only thing I would like to see is the full list of ingredients on the packaging.

I used the Wildfleur 2% Salicylic Acid Clarifying Toner for 2 weeks and unfortunately was very disappointed..! I was excited to try this product (and did absolutely love the packaging!) after receiving it for free in exchange for writing my review- but my skin didn't look or feel like I exfoliated neither immediately after using or after several days. While the product is described to have no scent, I could smell what can only be described as unnatural floral scent for a while after using. With so many exfoliating / clarifying toner products available, I will not continue to use this.

I was really surprised how this exfoliating toner is so mild on my skin. I started using it twice a week then three times a week after a few weeks and my skin reacted nicely. I can see a difference in how much after my face is and will definitely keep this in my skin routine.
I love everything about this toner! Great bottle/ cap, nice light scent, and easy to apply. It leaves my skin feeling nice and soft without a weird residue!

I started using the toner every other day after cleansing as suggested. I began to use the toner daily and I don't see any dryness or irritation. My skin has a slight glow and I'm sure the toner will help with my texture after some time. This toner doesn't feel as harsh or drying as some others I've tried & used in the past. I would definitely purchase this@ The packaging is awesome!
This toner is a great product for both acne prone skin, and for people who want to quickly exfoliate. I like that it really has no scent, and leaves my skin feeling both clean and still moisturized.

I used my product every morning after cleansing, I notice within a few days my face look and felt smoother. I notice my wrinkles on my face and throat look tighter. I really like the product and will continue using it daily .

avis.titre: Not into toners but loved this

I've been using the Clarifying Cleanser for the past two weeks, and I can confidently say that it has significantly improved my skin. The combination of 0.45% salicylic acid and flavonoids works wonders; my skin feels thoroughly exfoliated without being stripped of moisture. One of the standout features of this cleanser is its pH balance. It manages to cleanse deeply while keeping my skin's natural moisture barrier intact, which is crucial for my skin type. I've noticed a reduction in breakouts and an overall improvement in my skin texture. The formula is gentle yet effective, making it a great choice for anyone looking to clarify their skin without harsh side effects. If you're on the fence about trying it, I highly recommend giving it a shot. The results I've experienced speak for themselves!

Since my breakout cleared, I've been using it once a week on a cotton pad to help with my milia and acne scars. I'm excited to see how the toner helps with my skin!
*I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review* I really enjoy this toner! I find that it decreases breakouts but is also gentle on the skin.

avis.titre: Holy grail for glowing, glass skin
avis.texte: Thanks wildfleur for the opportunity to try the salicylic acid clarifying toner for free! For context, I have normal skin and my current skin concerns are hormonal breakouts along my chin/jawline and staving off premature aging. I admit that I have used toners in my skincare routine for years but never really thought they do anything - I'd never found one that seemed to make a difference! But I really love how my skin has responded to this one. I use it twice daily and have definitely noticed increased clarity and smoothness. It incorporated well into my routine and seems to really complement my other products (a lot of them also being K-beauty). I feel like this toner would work well on sensitive skin as I didn't notice any scent and it didn't cause any tingling or burning on my skin, nor did it dry me out or cause any peeling/flaking - which is impressive considering I use prescription tretinoin every night. It seems to fade any blemishes that pop up very quickly and keeps the sebaceous filaments on my nose at bay. I waited a while before writing this review to wait for the other shoe to drop, so to speak, but I have no complaints. For someone who has never had perfectly clear skin, this toner has made me feel like glowy, glass skin is actually attainable. I am over the moon with this toner and will definitely be repurchasing when I run out.
I used the toner after washing my face and it was refreshing, I like the scent and the fact it does not need to be rinsed off.
